models._description: (extension) registers the BIS3 order EDI builder + routes inbound UBL order XML to its importer
(extension) blocks (un)grouping invoice lines linked to a purchase order

behavioral_notes.observation: Outbound order export: _export_order builds a structured document_node via _get_purchase_order_node (header with CustomizationID 'urn:fdc:peppol.eu:poacc:trns:order:3', ProfileID 'urn:fdc:peppol.eu:poacc:bis:ordering:3', OrderTypeCode '105', QuotationDocumentReference=partner_ref; BuyerCustomerParty=own company, SellerSupplierParty=vendor, Delivery, PaymentTerms, cac:OrderLine, cac:AnticipatedMonetaryTotal) and renders it with dict_to_xml using the Order template (odoo.addons.account_edi_ubl_cii.tools.Order) + the BIS3 nsmap. It reuses the account.edi.xml.ubl_bis3 e-invoice machinery (_ubl_add_buyer_customer_party_node, _ubl_add_line_item_node, tax/monetary helpers) but emits a Peppol BIS Order document instead of an Invoice; _setup_base_lines additionally attaches each line's product.supplierinfo so SellersItemIdentification/Item Name carry the vendor's product_code/product_name. None of this node-mapping is visible in metadata.

Inbound order import: _retrieve_order_vals extends the account_edi_ubl_cii base, then walks the XML tree to retrieve-or-create the vendor via _import_partner('SellerSupplier') -> partner_id, the delivery party -> dest_address_id, sets partner_ref from ./ID and origin from OriginatorDocumentReference, parses './{*}OrderLine/{*}LineItem' through _import_lines(document_type='order', tax_type='purchase') plus _import_document_allowance_charges, and writes them as order_line Command.create(...) onto the purchase.order. _retrieve_line_vals renames the base 'quantity' key to 'product_qty' so the dict fits purchase.order.line (invoice-only deferred_start/end_date keys are popped). Cross-model side-effect chain (partner create, line create) invisible in metadata.

EDI dispatch wiring on purchase.order: _get_edi_builders appends env['purchase.edi.xml.ubl_bis3'] so the PDF report engine (purchase.ir_actions_report) embeds the generated BIS3 order XML inside the RFQ/PO PDF for every UBL build. Inbound, _get_import_file_type sniffs the parsed xml_tree's CustomizationID == 'urn:fdc:peppol.eu:poacc:trns:order:3' to tag the file as 'purchase.edi.xml.ubl_bis3', and _get_edi_decoder then returns that model's _import_order_ubl (defined in account_edi_ubl_cii) as the decoder at priority 20. _import_order_ubl writes the parsed vals onto the order, posts a 'Format used to import' message, and on partial data schedules a mail.mail_activity_data_todo via _create_activity_set_details. Pure Python routing, not declarative.

Document-integrity guard: this override raises a UserError ('You can only (un)group lines of an invoice not linked to a purchase order') whenever any account.move.line carries a purchase_order_id, blocking the bill-line (un)group-by-tax action for PO-backed vendor bills so the line<->purchase.order.line link that drives 3-way matching and stock valuation is never broken. Side-effect (a blocked action), invisible in metadata.

it_architecture.application: purchase_edi_ubl_bis3 (Peppol BIS Ordering 3 export/import engine, extends Purchase via the account_edi_ubl_cii UBL builders)
logical_data_erm: purchase.order.line <- order_line vals built by the importer (Command.create)
information_flows: side-effect (outbound): purchase.order PDF render -> _get_edi_builders -> _export_order -> Peppol BIS Order XML embedded in the RFQ/PO PDF

side-effect (inbound): UBL order XML/PDF -> _get_import_file_type (CustomizationID) -> _get_edi_decoder -> _import_order_ubl -> purchase.order written + order_line created + vendor (res.partner) retrieved/created
auto_install: true -> activates whenever both purchase and account_edi_ubl_cii are installed

capabilities: Export Purchase Orders as Peppol BIS Ordering 3 UBL XML
Import Purchase Orders / RFQs from UBL Order XML
Embed the Order XML inside the PO PDF (XML-in-PDF portability)
Map vendor product references (supplierinfo) into UBL Item identification
value_streams: Outbound: confirmed PO -> Peppol BIS Order XML -> XML embedded in PO PDF / sent to vendor
Inbound: received UBL Order XML/PDF -> format detection -> parsed purchase.order with vendor, delivery address & order lines
information_concepts: purchase.order (the order carrying the BIS3 Order XML)
purchase.order.line (order lines built from / serialized to UBL OrderLine)
res.partner (vendor / delivery party matched on import)
policies: Order format fixed to Peppol BIS Ordering 3 (CustomizationID urn:fdc:peppol.eu:poacc:trns:order:3) via header nodes
Auto-install with purchase + account_edi_ubl_cii: any Purchase+EDI database gains UBL order exchange by default
PO-linked vendor-bill lines cannot be (un)grouped by tax (account.move guard)
stakeholders: Vendor / Supplier (receives the UBL order, or whose RFQ is imported)
Peppol Access Point / e-procurement network (transport of the BIS Order)

classification.rationale: purchase_edi_ubl_bis3 is a thin procurement-support/compliance layer: it owns one AbstractModel (purchase.edi.xml.ubl_bis3) that serializes a purchase.order to, and parses it from, Peppol BIS Ordering 3 UBL XML, reusing the account_edi_ubl_cii e-invoice builders. It adds no primary-chain value of its own and has no models with storage, routes, views, or UI beyond the existing Purchase forms; its terminal side-effects are an embedded Order XML on the PO PDF (export) and a populated purchase.order (import). It supports APQC 4.2 Procure Materials and Services (the order-exchange leg, activity refs 4.2.4.4 create/distribute purchase orders and 4.2.4.5 expedite/track) by making PO exchange standards-compliant; it leans compliance, sitting alongside account_edi_ubl_cii's invoice EDI. value_model 'support' per Stabell & Fjeldstad: it is an infrastructure/compliance enabler for procurement document exchange, not a chain/shop/network in its own right.

standard_capabilities: Export a purchase order as Peppol BIS Ordering 3 (urn:fdc:peppol.eu:poacc:bis:ordering:3) UBL Order XML
Embed the Order XML inside the PO/RFQ PDF for receiver portability
Detect inbound UBL order format from CustomizationID and import into purchase.order
Retrieve-or-create the vendor and delivery party on import (via account_edi_ubl_cii partner matching)
Carry vendor product_code / product_name (product.supplierinfo) into SellersItemIdentification / Item Name
Reuse the EN16931/PINT tax & monetary computation of the shared UBL BIS3 builder
typical_fits: Buyer issuing standards-compliant Peppol BIS orders to vendors
Importing a vendor-supplied UBL order/RFQ to seed a purchase.order automatically
Round-trip of order data via XML-in-PDF where only the PDF is exchanged
common_gaps: Actual Peppol Access Point transmission (this module only builds/parses XML; network delivery is a separate Peppol module)
Order-response / order-change (BIS Order Response, Order Agreement) profiles beyond the plain Order
Country-specific CIUS or extra UBL extensions on the order not covered by the shared builder
Bespoke product/UoM/tax mappings for non-standard vendor catalogues
